falsification_conditions.condition: SPY closes above its 20-day rolling high within 14 days, with daily volume exceeding 150% of its 20-day average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff top pattern with confirmed volume expansion invalidates the HOLD signal; the 73% pattern match to March 2024 ETF top would be broken by price action that diverged from that prior topping structure, which saw no such breakout

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive days while SPY remains within 2% of its 14-day high
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This divergence—elevated fear persistence without price collapse—would falsify the pattern match; the March 2024 top featured VIX suppression during the final rally phase, so sustained VIX elevation with stable prices indicates a different regime than the matched pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: Aggregate ETF inflows (SPY, QQQ, IWM combined) exceed $15 billion in any single 3-day period
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The March 2024 top was characterized by distribution and slowing inflows in its final two weeks; a surge of this magnitude would demonstrate accumulation rather than distribution, breaking the structural similarity that underpins the 73% pattern match and HOLD signal

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
